scope: Implemented source provenance for all 67 registered optimization passes and the current production branches. This is a tested compiler capability, not a proof that arbitrary programs or all future optimizer changes are bug-free.
fallback: Unannotated writes invalidate their node origin; new nodes are unknown unless attributed explicitly.

passes.notes: Arithmetic, logical coercions, literal builtins, fraction/reciprocal and sign rewrites, and control-flow simplification retain expression or selected-operand origins. Missing operands of collapsed values stay unknown.
Approximate and exact-preserving numeric normalization keeps literal ranges through local/expression traversal; exact-sensitive contexts remain governed by the original optimization gates.
Initial values, compensation factors and original use expressions are attributed independently; unchanged surrounding nodes retain their own locations.
Copied point/width operands, rewritten binding references, zero bounds and conjunctions retain their defining comparisons. Only inserted storage syntax is synthetic.
Removed floor calls return their original induction-variable argument, while context and rejected noninteger/out-of-range loops preserve their original attribution.

Expanded arguments use the actual table values; generated direct callee expressions point to the helper callee and the expanded call retains its call site and helper relation. Removed declarations have no output.

Every common actual argument and the replaced parameter read are distinguished. Missing arguments have explicit implicit-nil attribution; surviving parameter slots are reindexed to original declaration positions.
User-function and builtin literal results retain call, body and actual-argument contributions. Rejected folds restore their unchanged provenance, and missing contributing input remains unknown.
Deleted split/recompose sequences retain surrounding blocks; square-to-abs recomposition attributes new algebra to the original expression without using a block fallback.
Retained call punctuation and arguments keep call/operand positions. Omitted arguments have no generated interval. Temporary normalization-only ASTs are separate from final product attribution.
Expanded actuals retain their table values; absent keys have explicit nil provenance. Rewritten field reads, generated scalar parameters and surviving original parameters keep distinct source slots.
Alpha copies, specialized bit expressions, current/old/pulse reads and filtered declaration slots retain their actual source constructs. New state/parameter storage is explicitly synthetic.
Bit masks, shifts, normalization units, rewritten definitions and direct/inverse consumers retain the corresponding source operands and original reads.
The floor quotient retains the original quotient and contributing modulo operands; retained remainder and replacement assignment keep distinct source statements.
Shared arithmetic nodes carry all selected remainder/quotient sites and divisor contributions. Each helper invocation retains its original pair; helper storage/control is synthetic.
Each replaced terminal quotient preserves its original use expression, and the new helper call retains the replaced remainder operation. Helper-reference plumbing is synthetic.
Fused assignments and divisor products retain every original divisor occurrence and initial value. Unknown factors do not become attributed through a known parent.
Copied expression subtrees preserve defining ranges and related original use locations. Moved statements and unaffected surrounding blocks remain attributed.
Each replaced use preserves its own expression plus the reused definition. Missing operands of the replaced use are not hidden by its enclosing expression range.
Remaining factors keep their positions; the carrier reference relates the actually replaced factor occurrences and its definition. Reassociated operators keep the original product expression.
Per-use factor subsets, shared coefficients and product operators retain their contributing operands. New storage is synthetic; signed and reordered products are tested.

Converted parameter references retain their old names/locations; removed returns and parameters have no output. Rewritten call/initialization sequences distinguish the caller target, arguments and callee.
Copied shared expressions keep their original subtrees. Per-use replacement references retain their own source expressions, and missing use operands remain unknown. New carrier storage is synthetic.
Alpha copies preserve original callback function/declaration/reference identities independently of the runtime slot they share.
Shared hit/active/action/color/draw operations and per-site arguments retain their selected source contributions. Invocation sites remain distinct; only helper/state-control plumbing is synthetic.
Moved default assignments preserve their original statements and modified decisions keep their source conditions rather than acquiring the insertion location.
Merged call wrappers and logical selection operators derive from the original decision; callees and arguments keep their own original positions.
If/elseif/no-else cases attribute new logical operators and destination statements separately from surviving operands and branch values.
Unchanged inspected nodes retain their origins. Partial assignment deletion preserves the surviving assignment and explicit nil; deleted writes have no generated intervals.
Nested scalar leaves preserve initializer and separate lookup-use ranges. Missing-key nil points to its lookup, survivor declaration slots are remapped, and unknown source leaves remain unknown.
Each scalarized field preserves its original access and named/quoted initializer key. Equal values do not merge field identities; surviving declarations retain the correct slots.
Scalar assignment/value reads retain fill and lookup positions. Outside-range nil and overlapping range guards retain bounds; unchanged traversal and declarations stay attributed.
Alpha-cloned body, arguments and internal locals retain definition-side positions with separate caller relations. Tail-return destinations use caller locations and related original return statements.
Expression copies preserve definition-side nodes, actual argument origins and parameter/call relations; installation never uses text matching or a reused NodeId as proof of provenance.
Substitution retains defining literals and per-read occurrences, including shadowed bindings. Surviving multi-name declaration slots are explicitly remapped.
Initializer subtrees preserve defining and use positions through chained substitutions. Removed bindings have no output and shifted survivor slots keep their original names.
Surviving initializers/statements retain their origins, discarded declarations receive no output, and retained binding slots are explicitly reindexed.
Removing eligible do wrappers preserves the original surviving child statements and their locations; local-bearing or jump-sensitive scopes remain unchanged.
Shared calls preserve their source sites and operands while new helper/wrapper structure is explicitly generated.
Merged wrapper calls and argument formulas retain the original constants and functions; caller locations remain separate from the merged definition.
Affine formulas preserve contributions from the original wrappers and each call; synthesized selector/control constants are explicitly generated.
New assignment/function nodes retain the original declaration and each converted name is transferred from its old binding slot.
Converted reads and declarations preserve distinct original occurrences even when runtime slots are shared. Only a newly inserted implicit nil is synthetic.
The shared origin-aware conversion handles frequency thresholds; retained locals and converted names preserve their own positions.
Unchanged, partially reduced and retained assignments keep their source statements. Removed stores have no generated range; traversal does not erase unrelated origins.
Copied defining expressions preserve their subtrees and original use relations; speculative appended nodes and metadata are truncated together on rejection.
Renamed reads retain their old identifier occurrences, reduced definitions retain their statements, and rejected trials leave both syntax and origin tables unchanged.
Only game-contract-unavailable globals are replaced. Their nil roots derive from the original name; dynamic or external bindings remain unchanged.
Every renamed occurrence retains its original name and range independently of other bindings sharing the generated slot.
Stored values keep their individual operand origins, channel/value/replay expressions retain the selected source series, and loop/storage control is explicitly synthetic.
Reassociated sums and per-use operands retain source expressions; the adjustment preserves original binding reads and offset operands. Inserted storage is synthetic.
Affine/constant/table argument columns retain contributing source operands, copied commands keep source locations, and loop/data-storage control is explicitly generated.
Periodic argument formulas retain their contributing source series separately from generated loop control; rejected fits and unchanged traversals preserve original attribution.
Replacements preserve their own use expressions plus the reaching definition; a missing use operand does not acquire the known parent position.
Normalized sign bases and per-use carrier reads retain their own expressions and a shared definition relation. Carrier storage is synthetic and unknown uses remain unknown.
The shared expression-copy/substitution path retains body/argument origins and call/parameter relations when reversing a one-use helper.
Surviving assignments, conditional branches and do blocks retain their origins across liveness traversal; eliminated stores do not acquire output positions.
Removed wrappers do not replace surviving child origins; required parentheses remain attributed to their actual retained expression.
Each original identifier slot retains its spelling and source occurrence independently of interned symbols or generated short-name reuse.
Rebuilt source subtrees and alias uses retain original builtin-access positions; only new alias storage definitions are synthetic.
Named keys, dot accesses and method sites retain per-occurrence names; quoted keys retain literal precision without invented original identifier spellings.
Static field/alias rewrites retain original key/use locations, surviving predeclaration slots are reindexed, removed guards/stores have no output, and new scalar storage is synthetic.
Shared literal uses and exact arithmetic representations retain actual numeric inputs and each source use. New storage is synthetic; missing inputs remain unknown.

Regular, baseline, enhanced, dense and shared portfolios record replay/callee/argument origins, table cells, encoded payloads, dictionaries and predictive seeds. Decoder control is distinguished from source data.
Retained commands and each helper invocation preserve original sites and argument contributions; generated helper storage/control is synthetic.
Merged declarations retain related original declarations and every appended binding slot is explicitly copied from its original occurrence.
Full returns and guard-return chains retain original decisions, operand branches and separate fallback-return locations.

additionalStages.notes: New specialized values derive from the original property call; unaffected source nodes and supported property types retain their existing contracts.
The shared lexical emitter records exact copied-token ranges; whitespace remains unmapped.
An unmodified source candidate carries its original snapshot and full-source group range.
Shared block-statement filtering changes only affected block attribution; inspecting unrelated nodes no longer invalidates their origins. Owning complex passes still require their separate audits.

completionContract.knownInput: Parsed/attributed input constructs remain Source or Derived; deliberate compiler-generated structures are Synthetic. Removed constructs have no generated interval.
completionContract.missingInput: Missing attribution is never recovered by source-text matching, reused node numbers, a wider parent anchor, or a synthetic-label fallback. Unknown remains a supported result for incomplete input provenance.
completionContract.testing: Every pass has a non-noop production-entry fixture, tracking-on/off AST and byte equality, both separator modes, JSON roundtrip and an erased-input negative. Additional semantic branches, partial-missing inputs, real compiler combinations and record codec portfolios are tested.
completionContract.runtimeBoundary: Compile-time source relationships do not reconstruct optimized-away variables, stack frames or a specific dynamic replay-loop iteration.

evidence.releaseApiStatus: Standard optimized Source Map v3, source-link composition and high-level SDK/Playground integration remain P4/P5 tasks.
